lines.english: "Here, this is the audio source data. It's from just before the show, so it's their best performance."
"Thanks, I owe you."
"I don't think I need to remind you not to pass this around to anyone, right? And I don't need to remind you about our promise either, do I?"
"Of course, of course. I'll introduce you to any of my underclassmen in the drama club you want me to. There's not one of them who can say no to me."
"You're a scary one. Even with all the members that the Drama Club has, it was just you performing all by yourself during the School Festival, Miss Club President…"
"At first, I took on a sort of elder-sister role for the club, you know? But eventually, it became obvious that not a single person could match my level."
"…Then that thing about you making three people quit during rehearsals is true as well?"
"Never mind that, just pick someone already, okay? Winter break is just around the corner, after all."
"Then, to keep things short, how about… the club's president?"
"Sorry, but I don't have the least bit of interest in guys. Rather, everything besides acting just annoys me."
"If not for your personality, you'd be a great girl though… What a shame…"
"So, what about my other request?"
"Eh? Ah… Err, right, was there something else?"
"You can stop playing stupid now. I asked you to introduce me to that guy, remember? Kitahara Haruki-kun."
"Well… he's not all that interesting of a guy, you know? He's a nosy class representative with good grades, so I don't think he's a good match for someone as selfi… uh, free-spirited as you, Senou…"
"I'll be the judge of that."
"…Hold on, didn't you just say you had no interest in guys?"
"I couldn't care less about him as a man, but I do have an interest in him as a male character."
"…You really should stop treating people like objects."
"Oh? That's rich coming from you, Iizuka-kun. Seeing as you're someone who has no qualms about using a hundred people as tribute, hoping at least one of them could substitute that one girl."
"Oh, sorry, my bad. A while ago, I kept an eye on you because you looked like you had some potential."
"You…"
"Don't worry, I have no interest in you anymore. I'm focused on that Kitahara-kun now, instead…"
"He just got a girlfriend, alright? Please, don't do anything that could mess that up."
"Aaah, just as I thought, they're together. It's that keyboardist girl, right?"
"…!? W-What makes you think it's the keyboardist!?"
"Well, it was really obvious just watching the show. They acted perfectly according to my script as well."
"…What do you mean?"
"That singer… Ogiso Setsuna, was it? They only looked at each other when she was facing the audience. It was so obvious that the two of them were hiding their relationship from her."
"…Aren't you just reading too deep into it?"
"I tuned out the music and focused on looking carefully at those three's eye movements. There's no way I'm wrong."
"That aside, what about that last song…? He's the one who wrote the lyrics, isn't he?"
"What about it?"
"No matter how you look at it, those lyrics don't fit Ogiso Setsuna's image at all, right?"
"The one he likes never pays attention to him, so all he can do is stare at her lonely back… doesn't really fit the ever-friendly Ogiso-san, does it now?"
"Meaning, if he's started going out with Ogiso-san, it's definitely because she stole him. I suppose that would make for an interesting plot twist."
"That's…"
"Oh, my… So it's actually true?
Ahaha, really now? Well, things just keep getting more and more interesting!"
"…Don't laugh at that. Is it really that funny?"
"Nah, I never said it was funny, but you have to admit that it's an interesting development."
"I said, don't laugh at that!"
"…Sorry. I shouldn't have shouted at you so suddenly."
"That was out of character, Iizuka-kun. If it were about yourself, you'd have just made a joke of it. I never knew you were such a thoughtful friend."
"Say whatever you want. But I won't ever let you meet Haruki. And, of course, not Setsuna-chan or Touma either."
"Don't you think your worries are misplaced, Iizuka-kun? I'm not interested in anything beyond that story between the three of them."
"Us earthlings could never hope to understand how an alien like you thinks."
"Oh, really now?"
"You're… actually scary. You just gave me the chills there."
"Yeah, I get that a lot, you know? Especially from people who see me acting."
"I see… So it's unrequited for the time being, huh?
Well, fine then. I won't give up, though."
"Suit yourself."
"I sure will. I've finally found an interesting scenario, after all."
"Graduation's just around the corner, either way."
